## Synopsis

Open an interactive SSH session (or run a single command) on an Edge
that is connected to the hub.

Examples:
```bash
# Interactive session
faros ssh my-server

# Run a single command (non-interactive)
faros ssh my-server -- echo hello
```


```bash
faros ssh <name> [-- command [args...]] [flags]
```
